background: The sedan is parked. The shop and palms outside stay fixed; a few distant leaves shift gently in the breeze.
continuity: Bruno stays in the driver seat. Darío is outside the frame near the shop.

shots.composition: A medium interior view shows Bruno, both hands and the horn pad in the reference framing.

His right palm presses the central pad once, then releases it. The wheel stays straight.
beats.sound: One short horn beep starts at visible pressure and stops at release.

beats.action: His right hand begins returning to the rim after the beep has ended.
Bruno angles his face toward Darío outside the window, eyebrows mildly tense, jaw moving naturally with his line.
beats.speaker: bruno
beats.delivery: with contained urgency, projecting toward the nearby shop

beats.action: His lips close. Both hands rest on the rim as he watches the shop and waits.

end_state: Bruno remains seated and expectant, with both hands on the wheel and the car still parked.
overall_soundscape: Quiet engine idle and subdued coastal street ambience persist. The single brief horn beep ends before Bruno speaks.
